    the best thing out of austria since mozart. pair with crispy mushrooms
  • domaine boutet saulnier - vouvray 2024 - chenin blanc - loire, fr17 - 68
    golden apple, honey, and a little mineral mischief. chenin does what chenin wants
  • maison brotte 'bord elegance' - laudun blanc 2025 - grenache blanc, marsanne, roussanne - rhone, fr14 - 56
    tastes like the french countryside without paying for the airfare
  • fossil & fawn - chardonnay 2024 - willamette valley, or16 - 64
    chardonnay with a sense of humor. not your granny's chardonnay
  • gilbert cellars 'tv wine' - rose 2025 - tempranillo, verdelho - yak valley, wa16 - 64
    is it rose? is it red? who cares! it's delicious
  • domaine dupre 'chai d'oevre' - morgon 2023 - gamay noir - beaujolais, fr17 - 68
    crunchy cherry, violets, & pepper. basically pinot noir after two espressos. pair with seared duck
  • domaine de couron - cotes du rhone 2024 - grenache, syrah - rhone, fr15 - 50
    if comfort food came in wine form
  • result of a crush 'unnamed' - syrah 2022 - walla walla, wa18 - 72
    dark fruit, pepper, savory herbs, smoked meat, and a little rustic swagger. pair with charred lamb chops
  • cadence winery 'coda' - red blend 2023 - merlot, petit verdot, cab franc, cab sauv - columbia valley, wa16 - 64
    big enough to make an entrance, civilized enough to not offend
  • ethos - cabernet sauvignon 2022 - columbia valley, wa15 - 50
    dark berries, and a long velvety finish. like putting on a tuxedo and refusing to explain yourself. pair with steak frites
